resolution.note: Stop removes empty untracked sandbox placeholders (package.json, .npmrc, .env.*) from the checkout before standards checks; regression test in test/hook/stop.test.ts

title: Sandbox placeholder files in a lane worktree do not fail standards checks at Stop
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/pilot-py/lanes/preflight-proof-py-2.log attempt t-03pvpwp exit=73 (release 32e764d): Stop refused s-test-command, s-test-exit-code, s-clean-checkout-tests because an untracked EMPTY package.json in the lane worktree makes JSON.parse fail; the worktree also holds empty untracked .npmrc .yarnrc .gitmodules .env.* (worktree /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot-py/lead/.krn/worktrees/t-03pvpwp; refusal in .krn/runs/stop-check/last-refusal.txt there). These are sandbox deny-write placeholders (settings.sandbox.json), not the agent change; same files appeared in pilot TS lanes.
Outcome: standards reflex checks and the Stop base/HEAD comparison ignore untracked empty sandbox placeholder files (or the lane removes them before Stop checks run), so a pilot-py note task passes Stop.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-run/environment.ts, .claude/settings.sandbox.json
Proof: a stop-hook test on a worktree with an untracked empty package.json raises no s-test-command refusal; a pilot-py drain attempt passes Stop.
